words.meaning: The relationship between companions; a feeling of fellowship or friendship.
words.sentence1: Their quiet companionship helped them weather the difficult winter together (Their quiet companionship helped them weather the difficult winter together).
words.sentence2: She found great companionship in her rescue dog during the long evenings (She found great companionship in her rescue dog during the long evenings).

words.meaning: Unity or agreement of feeling or action, especially among individuals with a common interest; mutual support within a group.
words.sentence1: La solidaridad entre los vecinos fue fundamental para reconstruir el barrio (The solidarity among the neighbors was fundamental to rebuild the neighborhood).
words.sentence2: Mostraron gran solidaridad con las familias afectadas por la tormenta (They showed great solidarity with the families affected by the storm).

words.meaning: The relationship between brothers or people with a shared interest or common purpose; brotherhood.
words.sentence1: La fraternité qui unissait ces artistes a duré toute leur vie (The fraternity that united these artists lasted their entire lives).
words.sentence2: Cet événement célèbre les valeurs de liberté, d'égalité et de fraternité (This event celebrates the values of freedom, equality, and brotherhood).

words.meaning: Benevolence, goodwill, or a kind and friendly disposition towards others.
words.sentence1: Er begegnete den neuen Kollegen stets mit offenem Wohlwollen (He always met the new colleagues with open goodwill).
words.sentence2: Ihr stetes Wohlwollen hat mir in dieser schwierigen Zeit sehr geholfen (Her constant goodwill helped me a lot during this difficult time).

words.meaning: Emotional contact, close communication, or a feeling of warmth through mutual connection.
words.sentence1: Chiiki no hito-tachi to no fureai ga watashi no kokoro o iyasu (The warm connection with the local people heals my heart).
words.sentence2: Dobutsu to no fureai wa kodomotachi ni totte taisetsu na keiken desu (Contact and connection with animals is an important experience for children).

words.meaning: Mutual support and a sense of shared responsibility among members of a group or community.
words.sentence1: La solidarietà dimostrata dai cittadini ha superato ogni aspettativa (The solidarity shown by the citizens exceeded all expectations).
words.sentence2: In quel momento difficile, ho capito il vero valore della solidarietà (In that difficult moment, I understood the true value of solidarity).

words.meaning: To share weal and woe together; to stick together through thick and thin in a deep bond.
words.sentence1: Tāmen shì gānyǔgòngkǔ de hǎo péngyǒu (They are good friends who share weal and woe together).
words.sentence2: Zài chuàngyè de jiānxīn rìzi li, dàjiā shǐzhōng gānyǔgòngkǔ (During the hard days of starting a business, everyone always stuck together through thick and thin).

words.meaning: Harmony, peace, and concord among people living or working together.
words.sentence1: Daehwaui cheotgeoreumeun seororeul injeonghaneun hwabae e itda (The first step of dialogue lies in harmony that acknowledges one another).
words.sentence2: Uri maegeun ooraejeonbuteo hwabaereul jungshihaewatda (Our village has valued harmony and concord since long ago).

words.meaning: The virtue of solidarity, unity, and harmonious coexistence among community members.
words.sentence1: Kar rkosa samakkethorm knong krousa chea kear samkhan nas (Maintaining unity and harmony within the family is very important).
words.sentence2: Puokkea ban banghien samakkethorm vea laor nas del phdl phlnh chaoy knea (They showed wonderful solidarity by helping each other).

words.meaning: A sense of togetherness, solidarity, and mutual belonging among people.
words.sentence1: Die gemeenskap het ’n sterk gevoel van saamhorigheid tydens die krisis getoon (The community showed a strong sense of togetherness during the crisis).
words.sentence2: Daardie naweekkamp het ’n wonderlike gevoel van saamhorigheid onder die vriende gebring (That weekend camp brought a wonderful sense of togetherness among the friends).
